content.query:
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY CbcCifNumber) AS Id,
    *
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CUST.ORGKEY AS CbcCifNumber,
        CASE 
            WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    ADDR.SUBURB, ' ',
                    ADDR.PREMISE_NAME, ' ',
                    ADDR.BUILDING_LEVEL, ' ',
                    ADDR.STREET_NAME
                )
            ELSE
                CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
                )
        END AS CbcContact,
        CASE 
            WHEN CPE.PHONEOREMAIL = 'EMAIL' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILID, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEOREMAIL, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE
                )
            ELSE
                CONCAT(
                    CPE.PHONENOCITYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOCOUNTRYCODE, ' ',
                    CPE.PHONENOLOCALCODE
                )
        END AS CbcContactDetail,
        CPE.PHONEEMAILTYPE AS CbcContactType,
        CASE 
            WHEN CPE.PREFERREDFLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Preferred'
            ELSE NULL
        END AS CbcPreferred
    FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_PHONEEMAIL CPE
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = CPE.ORGKEY
    LEFT JOIN EDS.CRM_ADDRESS ADDR
        ON CUST.ORGKEY = ADDR.ORGKEY
    WHERE CUST.STRUSERFIELD8 IS NOT NULL
        AND CUST.ISLATEST = 1
) TEMP
ORDER BY Id
